project_blurbs.name: Two-speed hand-crank generator
project_blurbs.sentence: built a two-speed hand-crank generator that charges a phone. I modelled it in SolidWorks, 3D printed the parts, and logged data with an Arduino to measure how efficient the drivetrain was (up to about 48%)

project_blurbs.name: Leader-follower robotic arm
project_blurbs.sentence: built a 4-DOF robotic arm that copies a hand-held twin in real time. I modelled it in SolidWorks, designed the circuit board in KiCad, and wrote the firmware
